testo:
Super Shield Trigger
■ Choose one of your opponent's creatures. That creature gets -5000 power until the end of the turn. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
S After you cast this spell from your hand, you may cast this spell from your graveyard for no cost.
